title: Cost of a list of actions
statement: Let $k$ and $n$ be natural numbers, and let a finite list consist of actions for a $k$-tape machine with Boolean symbols and states in the set of $n+1$ states. Its seek cost is the length of the concatenation of the action-bit encodings of the actions, plus three times the number of actions.
hypotheses_covered: The list is finite and consists of actions for a $k$-tape machine with Boolean symbols and states in a set of size $n+1$
caveat: The supplied context does not define the action-bit encoding, so its precise meaning cannot be stated.
